scope: Rendered client presentation from deterministic synthetic snapshots. Authoritative simulation, pathfinding, bots, network and population limits are outside this probe.
engine_timing_clock: Latest available UE stat unit 32-bit cycle counters at each scene tick. Pipeline stages may refer to different frames and are not additive. Zero engine readings are retained in raw samples and excluded from distributions.
scene_timing_clock: Previous completed game-thread scene and HUD frame. Scene update includes pose time, pose includes mesh submission, and hit includes its bounds work. These scopes are not additive.
vertex_counter_scope: Posed vertices in the scene diagnostic count CPU geometry work; viewport authored and buffer vertices describe displayed mesh data for both backends.
